kcc_query_text_example: SC marginal farmer in Ron taluk, Gadag with 1.5 acres borewell-irrigated onion and chilli; existing drip installed; heavy sunscald and thrips damaging crops; applying for 50% capital subsidy under MIDH for 1,000 m² shade net structure; need DPR guidelines.

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Ron taluk

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: DES Karnataka: Intensive vegetable and spice cultivators in Gadag (Ron/Shirhatti taluks), SC marginal holdings investing in protected cultivation.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Karnataka horticulture query logs: Smallholders inquiring about MIDH protected cultivation cost norms, polyhouse / shade net unit assistance.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Evaluates MIDH Protected Cultivation prerequisites: recognized horticulture crop (Onion), minimum structure land (1.5 ac >= 0.25 ac), and verified pre-existing micro-irrigation facility (Drip Irrigation installed); confirms clean pass for MIDH; verifies PM-KUSUM B disqualification due to grid IP set.

intended_test_purpose: Evaluate MIDH Protected Cultivation subsidy on marginal horticultural holding with pre-existing micro-irrigation; verify grid-connected water source disqualification under PM-KUSUM B.
unresolved_dependencies: Department of Horticulture MIDH action plan target allocation for shade net structures in Gadag district
